resources.string: No limit: after each answer, the next card is shown right away.
Change the card at every unlock
Off: an unanswered card stays until you answer it.
On: if you unlock without answering, another due card comes at the next lock. Skipped cards stay due in AnkiDroid; after an answer, the first card comes back.
The number of cards per unlock works once the live card wallpaper is set on the lock screen. Until then (or with the card picture), cards follow each other.
Works once the live card wallpaper is set on the lock screen.
Rotate through the first %1$d due cards
Above %1$d cards, the most urgent cards come back less often, and checking the card at each lock takes longer.
No card to review. Open Micro Review for AnkiDroid and select a deck.
Review the current card from your home screen.
Tick a deck below to start reviewing: its first card shows up in a notification.
Bravo! You\'ve finished all cards in the selected decks.
New cards will show up here when it\'s time to study.
Select your decks in Micro Review for AnkiDroid
Cards come from the first deck below that has one to review, then the next one. A deck includes its subdecks. Cards with sound in the question are skipped.
Tick decks in the list below to review them.
Either AnkiDroid is not installed, or its API is disabled. Enable it in AnkiDroid: Settings › Advanced › Enable AnkiDroid API.
Micro Review for AnkiDroid needs access to your AnkiDroid cards to show them.

AnkiDroid didn\'t give its decks: it may be updating, or its collection may be closed. Open AnkiDroid, then retry. If you just enabled its API, close AnkiDroid from the recent apps and open it again first.
Notifications are disabled: cards can\'t be reviewed from the notification. Enable them in the app\'s system settings.
Permission to read AnkiDroid cards was not granted.
Opens a new issue on GitHub, with your phone model, Android version and app versions already filled in. You can check and edit everything before sending it.
No browser found to open GitHub.
The license of this app and of the libraries it uses.
The lock screen shows the question. Tap Show answer in the notification to see the answer.
The lock screen shows the answer under the question, and the notification shows the answer buttons right away.
The lock screen shows the question. Tap Show answer in the review screen to see the answer.
The lock screen shows the answer under the question, and the review screen shows the answer buttons right away.
Review from the notification on the lock screen, without unlocking.
No notification: the card is on the lock screen, and the review screen opens when you unlock your phone.
Android only lets the app open the review screen with the \"Display over other apps\" permission. Until it is allowed, the notification is used.
Works once the live card wallpaper is set on the lock screen. Until then, the notification is used.
The home screen wallpaper shows through the widget. It can be darkened or lightened, but not blurred: the app can\'t read the wallpaper picture.
The card wallpaper is set on the lock screen.
The card wallpaper is not set on the lock screen
Needed to review cards from the notification.
Show cards on the lock screen
Set Micro Review for AnkiDroid as your lock screen wallpaper. It is also needed to show the card only while the phone is locked, one card per unlock; without it, the notification stays visible.
Background activity is restricted for this app, so new cards don\'t show up. Set its battery usage to Optimized or Unrestricted.
Set a picture of the current card as your lock screen wallpaper. It changes with each card; your home screen wallpaper stays unchanged.
On this device, the live card wallpaper is also your home screen wallpaper. A picture of the card can be set on the lock screen only instead.
Answer hidden on the lock screen? Allow sensitive notifications in your phone\'s notification settings.
The current card, with its answer and the review buttons. Shown on the lock screen.
A card to review at the times chosen in the app\'s settings.
Off: cards only come on the lock screen.
On: at each time below, a notification offers the current card. Tap Start to see the question. It may come a few minutes late.
Add a time to get a notification.
Shows the card to review on the lock screen.

In the wallpaper settings:

1. Select the Lock screen preview (not Home screen).
2. Open the wallpaper list, choose Live wallpapers, then Micro Review for AnkiDroid.
3. When asked where to apply it, choose Lock screen only.

Your home screen wallpaper stays unchanged.

Micro Review for AnkiDroid sets a picture of the current card as your lock screen wallpaper, and changes it with each card. Your home screen wallpaper stays unchanged.

Your current lock screen picture is replaced, and the app can't put it back.

If the card doesn't show on your lock screen, turn off the lock screen features that change the picture by themselves (for example Magazine unlock or Glance).
A live wallpaper is also possible on this device, but it replaces your home screen wallpaper too, and some lock screens don\'t show it.
The card picture is now your lock screen wallpaper.
The card picture is now your lock screen wallpaper. Your home screen still has the live card wallpaper: choose your home screen picture again in the wallpaper settings.
Your home screen still has the live card wallpaper (a plain background). Choose your home screen picture again: the app can\'t put the previous one back.
This device doesn\'t let apps change the lock screen picture.
A picture of the current card is your lock screen wallpaper. It changes with each card.

Card not showing on your lock screen? Turn off the lock screen features that change the picture by themselves (for example Magazine unlock or Glance). With a picture, the notification stays visible and cards follow each other.
Cards while you use your phone
A card pops up every so often while the screen is on and unlocked. Never shown on the lock screen.
Kept running so cards can come while you use your phone and chosen apps can be gated. Its buttons snooze the cards.
Cards come while you use your phone.
Your chosen apps ask for cards first.
Cards come while you use your phone, and your chosen apps ask for cards first.
Quiet hours: no cards for now.
Do Not Disturb is on: no cards for now.
In a call: no cards for now.
Your PC is in use: everything is paused.
Bluetooth device connected: everything is paused.
Next card in %1$d min of use.
Cards while you use your phone
If Android says a setting is restricted for this app: open the app\'s info page (long-press its icon, then App info), tap the three dots, then \"Allow restricted settings\", and come back.
Lets the app see which app is in front, to time the cards per app and to gate the apps you chose. Nothing leaves your phone.
Lets the gate and full-screen cards open over the app in front.
No cards for a while. Also on the monitor\'s notification and on each card.
Off: a snooze stops the cards, but gated apps still ask for theirs.
Cards while you use your phone

A card pops up every so often, only while the screen is on and unlocked, never on the lock screen. Answer it and you\'re done, or keep going. A card you don\'t touch is withdrawn, so its time doesn\'t count.
None. For example a card every 5 minutes on your biggest time wasters, or never on your maps app.
On: the card covers the app you\'re in until you answer or snooze it, and a video behind it pauses. Off: a pop-up notification instead; tap it to see the whole card.
%1$d seconds. It stays due and comes back with the next card.
Show the note\'s fields under the answer
On the full-screen card: every field of the note the card didn\'t show, such as the meaning or the reading, so a definition left off the card\'s back is still there.
Pass records Good and Fail records Again. Hard and Easy are never offered, anywhere in the app.
Ask for cards before chosen apps
Opening one of them first asks for a few cards. Pass or Fail, each answer counts. No grace period: close the app and open it again, and it asks again. Nothing due means no gate.
While a Bluetooth device is connected
Everything pauses: no cards, the gate is open, no reviews at set times. For example in the car or with headphones at work.
Without the \"Nearby devices\" permission, only Bluetooth audio (car, headphones, speakers) is detected, not watches or keyboards.
No cards while Do Not Disturb or another mode silences notifications.
No cards while you are in a call.
None. For example no cards from 22:00 to 07:00.
Cards while you use your phone
Pause while my PC is in use
With Micro Review Desktop, the Anki add-on, on your PC: cards and the gate pause for 5 minutes after you last use its mouse or keyboard.
In Anki on your PC: Tools › Micro Review Desktop. Type the pairing code shown there.
Pause while my PC is in use
No cards, the gate is open, for 5 minutes after you last use your PC\'s mouse or keyboard. Your PC tells the phone through ntfy.sh, a free relay: only a number of seconds is sent.
Answers wait to be synced. Asked AnkiDroid last: %1$s. Asked again after your next cards (at most every 15 min), or now.
Nothing waiting. Asked AnkiDroid last: %1$s. If it doesn\'t sync on mobile data, allow it in AnkiDroid › Settings › Sync.
